summary: Iteration 25 routing fix verified. 9/10 acceptance tests PASS. The core fix (ProtectedRoute loginPath prop for /admin) works correctly: unauthenticated /admin now redirects to /admin/login (form renders with email/password inputs and Back button visible). Direct /admin/login loads the form immediately; the Back arrow returns to /. Admin login (admin@taxi.local/admin123) navigates to /admin and renders panel content (Обзор/Заказы/Водители/Пассажиры/Настройки visible). Logged-in admin visiting /admin/login triggers the new useEffect auto-redirect back to /admin (no form flash). Direct /admin as an authenticated admin loads immediately. Regression checks pass: /customer and /driver unauth both redirect to / (default loginPath preserved); landing has no visible 'Вход для администратора' entry (test_mode=false). The only FAIL is TEST8 — Logout from /admin: expected redirect to /admin/login per iter25 spec, but user lands on / instead. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.js line 549-552 handleLogout calls navigate('/') explicitly after logout(), overriding the ProtectedRoute redirect. Fix is 1-line: change to navigate('/admin/login') OR simply remove the navigate() call so ProtectedRoute triggers on the now-null user. Confirmed on backend URL https://order-sync-platform-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend not tested per request. Total 0 console errors across all navigations.

integration_issues.flow: Admin logout redirect target (iter25 acceptance criterion)
integration_issues.issue: handleLogout in AdminPanel.js explicitly calls navigate('/') after await logout(), so the user lands on RoleSelect (/) instead of /admin/login. Per iter25 spec — 'Logout из /admin → ProtectedRoute срабатывает, редирект на /admin/login' — this must go to /admin/login. Fix: change /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.js line 551 from navigate('/') to navigate('/admin/login'), or remove the navigate() call entirely and let ProtectedRoute (with loginPath='/admin/login') handle the redirect once user becomes null.

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.js handleLogout (line 549-552): replace navigate('/') with navigate('/admin/login') OR remove the explicit navigate so ProtectedRoute takes over. This is required to satisfy iter25 spec for logout flow.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js L60-80: ProtectedRoute with loginPath prop is clean and correct — both !user and role-mismatch branches use the same loginPath, so an authenticated customer hitting /admin will land on /admin/login (verified logically; couldn't create runtime customer without SMS since test_mode=false, but code path is identical to the verified unauth branch).
AdminLogin.js L20-24: useEffect auto-redirect for already-authenticated admin is race-safe (guarded by !authLoading) — no form flash observed in TEST5.

AdminPanel.js L549-552: handleLogout hardcodes navigate('/') — inconsistent with the new loginPath convention introduced in iter25. Should either delegate to ProtectedRoute (recommended: just call await logout(); the null-user state will trigger Navigate to /admin/login automatically on next render) or navigate explicitly to /admin/login.
Consider also auditing any other explicit navigate('/') calls on 401/token-expiry paths to align with the new admin-scoped login route.

rca of the issue: AdminPanel.handleLogout (line 550-551) does: await logout(); navigate('/'). The context logout() clears user state, but the immediate navigate('/') push happens before React's next render, so ProtectedRoute never gets a chance to run its Navigate(loginPath='/admin/login') logic. Two valid fixes: (1) Remove the navigate('/') line — the very next render sees user=null and ProtectedRoute at /admin renders <Navigate to='/admin/login' replace/>. (2) Change to navigate('/admin/login', {replace:true}) for explicit control. Option 1 is more DRY and consistent with the iter25 loginPath design.
